policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: The combined rebased #128 and #176/#538/#550 client changes extend modal-history ownership, private navigation suppression, nested-modal accessibility, and navigation-ledger coverage in the instrumented client/core scope. Three clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-08-02 each passed all 2,011 tests across 243 files with zero unhandled errors and reproduced exactly 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). Relative to the reviewed #128 main baseline of 2,738/3,128 (87.532%), the combined tree adds 73 instrumented lines and 70 covered lines while increasing coverage percentage. The exact observed envelope needs no instrumentation tolerance, so the new floor is 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, observed-high-water, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The rebased combined #592 and #595 tree retains the transport-neutral first-party invocation coordinator and installed Hidden Content, Spoiler Guard, and typed Seerr owners, then adds a test-owned native pilot conformance matrix over the real actor, body, lifecycle, capability, prepared-context, idempotency, admission, audit, fixed-dispatch, and coordinator components. The matrix includes authentic wrong-operation mismatch, lifecycle-filter cancellation arbitration, observable redaction surfaces, and direct capability-ledger, idempotency, and admission capacity negatives without adding production lines or changing the 43,927-line instrumented plugin scope. Three clean local Coverlet runs on the identical 2026-08-03 combined source each passed all 3,075 server tests and reproduced exactly 34,752/43,927 covered lines (79.113%); the clean GitHub Actions Linux run passed the same 3,075 tests and measured 34,751/43,927 (79.111%). Relative to merged #595 main's reviewed high-water of 34,744/43,927 (79.095%), #592 raises the covered-line high-water by eight at fixed scope. The exact observed four-run envelope is 34,751-34,752, so the minimal one-line instrumentation tolerance preserves a new floor of 34,751/43,927 (79.111%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, observed-high-water, spread, single-run, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
